module: Test tool: periodically records vehicle metrics (time, position, quaternion rotation, and in extended mode temperatures, RPM, fuel, speeds, brake and engine thermals) into a CSV report written with csvlib when disable() is called. Reads electrics.values and powertrain.getDevicesByType('combustionEngine').
usage:
extensions.load('test_csvMetrics')
test_csvMetrics.enable('metrics.csv', 64, nil)
-- ...
test_csvMetrics.disable() -- writes the file
notes: Bug: `logExtendedMetrics = extended == nil and true or false` gives true only if extended is nil; passing extended=true gives false (simple mode) and extended=false also gives false. Extended mode is therefore obtained by passing nil.
A row is written every `rate` frames (frame % rate == 0), not at a fixed time interval; the default is 64 frames. The frame counter starts at 1 and is only reset to 1 by disable().
The time (Time column) is the sum of the dt received, in seconds; the ambient temperature is converted from K to °C (obj:getEnvTemperature() - 273.15); the rotation is the quaternion (x,y,z,w).

Header: the engine thermal columns are only added if device.thermals ~= nil, but writeRow always adds 4 values per engine and indexes v.thermals without a test: error if an engine has no thermals, and misaligned columns.
Wheel columns: 3 columns per entry of electrics.values.wheelThermals (BrakeCoreTemp, BrakeSurfaceTemp, BrakeThermalEfficiency); electrics.values.wheelThermals must exist.
csvFile is not written until disable() is called; disable() without a prior enable() would crash (csvFile nil).

enable.desc: Starts recording: stores the output path and the rate, builds the CSV header (simple or extended) and enables updateGFX.

path.desc: Path of the CSV file written by disable().

writeRate.desc: One row every N frames; 64 if nil.

extended.desc: nil = extended metrics; any other value = simple metrics (see notes, inverted behavior).

updateGFX.desc: Called every graphics frame (extensions.hook('updateGFX')). If enabled, accumulates time and writes a row every `rate` frames.

disable.desc: Writes the accumulated CSV to disk (csvData:write(path)), disables recording and resets the frame counter to 1.
